summary: The change edits only mortgage Retention.isPurgeDue. It still purges declined and withdrawn NPI after the retention period, but a legal hold no longer stops a purge when the case is withdrawn. That breaks RET-1, and the exception register has no approved, in-scope waiver. Ticket, independent approval on the head commit, and a green suite including the registered retention control test are in order, but they do not cure the hold bypass. The change is rejected.
